pages.text: Horizon alpha: this version supports one fixed 3×3×3 boiler. Build a hollow 3×3×3 shell. Put the Steam Boiler Array Controller at the center of the north wall, facing north, with its opening toward the inside. Every corner must be casing; the other shell blocks can be casing or Pressure Glass. Keep the single interior block empty. The Wrench reports whether the shell is formed.

Insert Water Buckets into the controller. It returns empty buckets in the second slot. Feed heat from a supported heat producer or Thermal Conduit. At 100°C it boils water into Steam for 8 HU/mB; at 500°C it outputs High-Pressure Steam for 12 HU/mB; at 900°C it outputs Superheated Steam for 16 HU/mB. Extract gas from the output tank with a compatible fluid network. This alpha has no pressure selector or overpressure venting and does not support the larger, taller source boiler structures yet.
